parameters.name: Asc
parameters.description:
The sorting order of property records by time in the response. Valid values:

- 0: reverse chronological order.
- 1: chronological order.

> **StartTime** must be earlier than **EndTime**. The system automatically converts the values based on the sorting order.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name that you want to query.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the property records. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.description:
The identifier of the property.

- For weak validation, you can view the property **Identifier** of the device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console. You can also call [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) to view the identifier in the returned Thing Specification Language model information.
- For validation-free mode, the identifier must be the same as the custom **identifier** used when the device reports properties.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device that you want to query. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.

><notice> **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If the ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or **ID** value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description: The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include this token in the next request to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of data records that can be returned for a single property. Maximum value: 100.

The number of data records returned for any property does not exceed this value.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the property records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds.
